hotspots.name: The Street Door
hotspots.description: The bolt is still thrown. The police broke the frame around it rather than cut it, which is the one careful thing anybody did here.

hotspots.name: The Shutters
hotspots.description: Nailed from the inside, and the nail heads are bright. A man who has decided a window is a way in does this, and does not tell his friends why.

hotspots.name: Welch McGovern
hotspots.description:
Upright at his own desk with his pen still in his hand and nothing wrong with him at all.

You were found like this. In your own room, at your own desk, eight days ago, and the only difference in the account is a revolver.

hotspots.name: A Copper Plumb
hotspots.description: A weight on a waxed thread, lying where it dropped beside his hand. It has stopped swinging. It has not stopped pointing.

hotspots.name: The Desk
hotspots.description: Two cups, both poured. One is empty and one is cold and full. His inkwell is open and his blotter has one clean corner where a second man's elbow rested.

hotspots.name: McGovern’s Notebook
hotspots.description: His own stitching, his own hand, and one leaf cut out close to the thread. He kept a list of everyone who came to the gathering. Your name is on it, in his writing, and seeing it is worse than it should be.

hotspots.name: The Cash Box
hotspots.description: Unlocked, on the shelf, a yard from the body, with eleven pounds and some silver in it. Whatever came here did not come for that, and neither did the man who waited downstairs.

locked.reason: It is locked, and the key is not on the body. Sergeant Gorman has the key — or a set of picks would do it.

hotspots.name: The Cellar Stair
hotspots.description: Coal dust on the third step and the fifth, dry, tracked upwards. It rained until eight. Somebody came up out of there after that.

hotspots.name: The Curio Shelf
hotspots.description: The occult as a party trick: a scrying bowl with a chip out of it, three tarot decks, a mounted moth, and a gap in the dust the size of a small book.
